items.title: Korea raises data breach fines to 10% of revenue
items.blurb: South Korea's revised privacy law allows fines of up to 10% of revenue for major data breaches and requires 72-hour notifications for high-risk personal data exposure.

items.title: The Implications of Linguistic Illegibility for LLM Security
items.blurb: LLMs are trained to generate natural language. However, various strands of evidence indicate that an LLM's externalized linguistic outputs and mechanistically-extracted linguistic features can be an unreliable lens for understanding…
